They defeat Goliath's army by Allah's permission, David kills Goliath and is given kingship and prophethood, and Allah checks some people by others to keep the earth from corruption.
David and Solomon judged a case of sheep overrunning a field, with Solomon given understanding; the mountains and birds glorified Allah with David, who was taught to make armor.
Allah favored David: the mountains and birds echoed praises with him, iron was made pliable for him, and he was told to make coats of mail and do righteous work.
Be patient and remember David, with whom mountains and birds praised Allah; tested by two disputants, he sought forgiveness and was told to judge with truth.
